title: equip_kit@1
description: Equipment art kit manifest (presentation only). equip_kit@1 is the first version of this document: there is no earlier body to migrate, the same way item@1, spell@1 and manifest@1 have no inbound migration. It is not a sim content document, it is not registered in the engine schema registry, and it is not folded into Combat::hash, log_hash, or chunk content_hash. A later mechanical change to an existing field would be equip_kit@2 with an identity migration of this body. Loose PNGs stay in the PR A layout under the kit root ({content_id}/{part}.{view}.png, optional {content_id}/{bin}/ for a size override, _kind/{weapon|shield|light|other}/ for the kind fallback). view is se (toward) or ne (away). West is an engine mirror and has no file or field. One pivot per sprite; absent means bottom-centre of the cell (width/2, height-1). H4 cells are 24x24 and H4's provisional pivot is [12, 20] where that art names one. Do not author a non-medium bin until that art exists. back_role is optional per content_id (quiver, bolt_case, pack, other). Shields and two-handed weapons omit it. neck is the holy-symbol amulet part and has the toward view only. Per-body attach tables are not this file.

part_name.description: PR A parts, plus neck for a holy symbol amulet. hip is the sheathed or belt view; the renderer assigns the side. There is no hip-main, hip-off, hip-left, or hip-right.

view_name.description: se is toward, ne is away. sw and nw are not stored.

bin_name.description: Optional size-bin override. Omitted means the flat medium file. A non-medium bin is the second key and falls back to medium in the loader. Do not populate one until that art exists.

pivot.description: The one pixel that sits on the attach point. The validator requires it inside the cell. Absent: bottom-centre.

region.description: Rectangle in the optional atlas. The loader still reads the loose PNG. name, when set, is the content id's last segment plus the view (quiver.se), matched whole, not as a substring.

back_role.description: Optional. Set on a quiver, a bolt case, or a backpack. Omit it on a shield or a two-handed weapon.

kind_entry.description: Kind fallback, medium only, at _kind/{kind}/{part}.{view}.png. No back_role and no size bin: the loader does not read those on a kind.

cell.description: Sprite cell in pixels. H4 is [24, 24]. Every loose PNG and every atlas region is this size.

atlas.description: Optional atlas PNG in this directory. Tools may pack the loose PNGs into it. The loader reads the loose files.

items.description: One entry per content_id. Empty when no sprite file exists yet. Ids are matched whole.
